chapter: Eddie South, high school and the South Side scene
title: Dan Burley, Lionel Hampton and the origins of Jet; Taylor hears him in Harlem
summary: Burley helped organize Hampton's first band and Jet; Taylor recalls him dropping in at Joe Wells's in Harlem.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: No kidding. How did that happen?
Well Dan and Lionel were very close and Dan helped Lionel organize his first band. I‟ve got that on tape here. I [unintelligible] his house and they‟ve got that…
and these guys in Austria said, I‟ve got a new album that they put out, just collected all of Dan Burney‟s music from everywhere.

Oh, really? He was quite… I heard him play. As a matter of fact, he was the first one I ever heard play skiffel. I mean I heard other kinds of boogie-woogie, but this house rent kind of thing… he was the editor of the Amsterdam News.
I was playing up at Wells in Harlem and he come in and we said, “Boy, you don‟t know anything about this”, and he‟d sit down and I said, “You‟re right, I don‟t” [laughter].
Dick Hyman… I spoke to Dick Hyman about it. He gave Dick Hyman his first job in Harlem.

Right, at Wells, yeah, because he used to come in all the time. He loved piano players. He used to tell Joe Wells, he said, “Look, you‟ve got to have a piano player I can come listen to” [laugher]. He said, “I don‟t want to hear this” [laughter].
